title: Ethiopian Chicken Doro Wot with German Twist
description: A German inspired version of the traditional Ethiopian Doro Wot, featuring chicken cooked in a rich and aromatic sauce. This dish is a delicious fusion of cultures and cuisines.
instructions: Season the chicken thighs with salt and set aside.
Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the chicken until browned on both sides, about 5 minutes per side.
Remove the chicken from the pot and set aside.
Add the onion, ginger, and garlic to the pot and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the Berbere spice and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken broth and heavy cream to the pot and stir to combine.
Return the chicken to the pot and bring the sauce to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, for 20-25 minutes.
Serve the chicken and sauce over rice or with naan bread.
